approval_basis: Explicit user approval in the project conversation on 2026-10-21; release owner must separately authorize the exact release SHA and tag.
scope: OSS package distribution of Agentegrity v0.13.0 only; opt-in CrewAI extra and separately installed legacy AI SDK v5 peers/test fixture; NOT approval of vulnerable production deployments.
mandatory_controls: Base Python wheel contains no required runtime dependencies; no vulnerable CrewAI/ChromaDB/MCP/uv libraries vendored in released archives.
All seven npm package tarballs ship without legacy ai5, undici 5 or busboy 2 runtime dependencies.
No public exposure of affected Chroma Python server endpoints, cross-tenant data, or vulnerable MCP stateful HTTP paths is authorized.
No production use of unpatched AI SDK v5/Undici/Busboy services is authorized by this disposition.
New advisories, package/version changes or expiry return to NO-GO; reapproval required.
Publishing still requires successful tests, registry preflight and separate explicit release owner GO for the exact tag SHA.
